name: Work Requests - Create and manage service requests
description: Verifies the full work request lifecycle from creation through approval and conversion to order

planSteps.description: Assert that the work requests list is displayed with status badges (pending, approved, rejected, converted)
Click 'New Work Request' and fill in the form: client details, service description, priority, requested date
Submit the work request and verify it appears in the list with 'pending' status
Open the work request detail and click 'Approve'
Assert that the status changes to 'approved' and a 'Convert to Order' button appears
Click 'Convert to Order' and verify it navigates to order creation pre-filled with work request data
Assert that after conversion, the work request status shows 'converted' with a link to the new order
